propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC live mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no generic retry wrapper, best_effort fallback, or duck-typed production path reachable.
Unsupported production actions must fail with a typed provider-neutral pre-effect error before local or remote effects occur.
Preview, manifest, and logs must preserve existing mutation fields while adding versioned redacted logical-attempt, lifecycle, delay, budget, disposition, fuse, and retry_not_before data.

State advancement of cursor, baseline, and binding must occur only for proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown work must never be counted as applied and must remain recoverable.
The repair_at_write_boundary call in reconcile.py must execute after staleness validation but before the first remote issue fetch, and must remain anchored when load phases are refactored.
